ipa.financial_contracts.cap_floor.Definition

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.cap_floor.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    *,
    instrument_tag: str | None = None,
    start_date: OptDateTime = None,
    end_date: OptDateTime = None,
    tenor: str | None = None,
    notional_ccy: str | None = None,
    notional_amount: float | None = None,
    index_name: str | None = None,
    index_tenor: str | None = None,
    interest_payment_frequency: Frequency | str = None,
    interest_calculation_method: DayCountBasis | str = None,
    payment_business_day_convention: BusinessDayConvention | str = None,
    payment_roll_convention: DateRollingConvention | str = None,
    index_reset_frequency: Frequency | str = None,
    index_reset_type: IndexResetType | str = None,
    index_fixing_lag: int | None = None,
    amortization_schedule: list[AmortizationItem] | None = None,
    payment_business_days: str | None = None,
    adjust_interest_to_payment_date: AdjustInterestToPaymentDate | str = None,
    stub_rule: StubRule | str = None,
    barrier_definition: BarrierDefinitionElement | None = None,
    buy_sell: BuySell | str = None,
    interest_calculation_convention: InterestCalculationConvention | str = None,
    payments: list[InputFlow] | None = None,
    annualized_rebate: bool | None = None,
    cap_digital_payout_percent: float | None = None,
    cap_strike_percent: float | None = None,
    cms_template: str | None = None,
    floor_digital_payout_percent: float | None = None,
    floor_strike_percent: float | None = None,
    index_fixing_ric: str | None = None,
    is_backward_looking_index: bool | None = None,
    is_rfr: bool | None = None,
    is_term_rate: bool | None = None,
    fields: OptStrStrs = None,
    pricing_parameters: PricingParameters | None = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
    index_price_side: PriceSide | None = None,
    cap_strike_percent_schedule: dict | None = None,
    floor_strike_percent_schedule: dict | None = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
instrument_tag str | None No None User defined string to identify the instrument.It can be used to link output results to the instrument definition. Only alphabetic, numeric and '- _.#=@' characters are supported. Optional.
start_date OptDateTime No None The option start date
end_date OptDateTime No None The maturity date of the CapFloor
tenor str | None No None Tenor of the option
notional_ccy str | None No None The ISO code of the notional currency. Mandatory if instrument code or instrument style has not been defined. In case an instrument code/style has been defined, value may comes from the reference data.
notional_amount float | None No None The notional amount of the leg at the period start date. Optional. By default 1,000,000 is used.
index_name str | None No None The name of the floating rate index.
index_tenor str | None No None The period code that represents the maturity of the floating rate index. Mandatory when the leg is float.
interest_payment_frequency Frequency | str No None The frequency of the interest payments. Optional if an instrument code/style have been defined : in that case, value comes from reference data. Otherwise, it is mandatory.
interest_calculation_method DayCountBasis | str No None The Day Count Basis method used to calculate the coupon interest payments. Mandatory.
payment_business_day_convention BusinessDayConvention | str No None The method to adjust dates to a working day.
payment_roll_convention DateRollingConvention | str No None The method to adjust payment dates whn they fall at the end of the month (28th of February, 30th, 31st). Optional. By default 'SameDay' is used.
index_reset_frequency Frequency | str No None The reset frequency in case the leg Type is Float. Optional. By default the IndexTenor is used.
index_reset_type IndexResetType | str No None A flag that indicates if the floating rate index is reset before the coupon period starts or at the end of the coupon period. Optional. By default 'InAdvance' is used.
index_fixing_lag int | None No None Defines the positive number of working days between the fixing date and the start of the coupon period ('InAdvance') or the end of the coupon period ('InArrears'). Optional. By default 0 is used.
amortization_schedule list[AmortizationItem] | None No None Definition of amortizations
payment_business_days str | None No None A list of coma-separated calendar codes to adjust dates (e.g. 'EMU' or 'USA'). Optional. By default, the calendar associated to NotionalCcy is used.
adjust_interest_to_payment_date AdjustInterestToPaymentDate | str No None A flag that indicates if the coupon dates are adjusted to the payment dates. Optional. By default, 'false' is used.
stub_rule StubRule | str No None The rule that defines whether coupon roll dates are aligned on the maturity or the issue date. Optional. By default, 'Maturity' is used.
barrier_definition BarrierDefinitionElement | None No None
buy_sell BuySell | str No None The side of the deal. Possible values:
- Buy
- Sell
interest_calculation_convention InterestCalculationConvention | str No None
payments list[InputFlow] | None No None
annualized_rebate bool | None No None
cap_digital_payout_percent float | None No None
cap_strike_percent float | None No None Cap leg strike expressed in %
cms_template str | None No None A reference to a common swap contract that represents the underlying swap in case of a Constant Maturity Swap contract (CMS). Mandatory for CMS contract.
floor_digital_payout_percent float | None No None
floor_strike_percent float | None No None Floor leg strike expressed in %
index_fixing_ric str | None No None The RIC that carries the fixing value. This value overrides the RIC associated by default with the IndexName and IndexTenor. Optional.
is_backward_looking_index bool | None No None
is_rfr bool | None No None
is_term_rate bool | None No None
fields OptStrStrs No None Contains the list of Analytics that the quantitative analytic service will compute.
pricing_parameters PricingParameters | None No None The pricing parameters to apply to this instrument. Optional. If pricing parameters are not provided at this level parameters defined globally at the request level are used. If no pricing parameters are provided globally default values apply.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters
index_price_side PriceSide | None No None The side that is selected for an index supporting Bid/Ask/Mid (which is the case of deposits).
cap_strike_percent_schedule dict | None No None The schedule of the dates and cap strike rates. The rates are expressed in percentages. Either capStrikePercent or capStrikePercentSchedule must be provided. No default value applies.
floor_strike_percent_schedule dict | None No None The schedule of the dates and floor strike rates. The rates are expressed in percentages. Either FloorStrikePercent or FloorStrikePercentSchedule must be provided. No default value applies.

Example

import lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts as ldf
definition = ldf.cap_floor.Definition(
   instrument_tag="CapOnCms",
   stub_rule=ldf.cap_floor.StubRule.MATURITY,
   notional_ccy="USD",
   start_date="2018-06-15",
   end_date="2022-06-15",
   notional_amount=1000000,
   index_name="Composite",
   index_tenor="5Y",
   interest_calculation_method="Dcb_Actual_360",
   interest_payment_frequency=ldf.cap_floor.Frequency.QUARTERLY,
   buy_sell=ldf.cap_floor.BuySell.BUY,
   cap_strike_percent=1,
   pricing_parameters=ldf.cap_floor.PricingParameters(
       skip_first_cap_floorlet=False, valuation_date="2020-02-07"
   ),
   fields=[
       "InstrumentTag",
       "InstrumentDescription",
       "StartDate",
       "EndDate",
       "InterestPaymentFrequency",
       "IndexRic",
       "CapStrikePercent",
       "FloorStrikePercent",
       "NotionalCcy",
       "NotionalAmount",
       "PremiumBp",
       "PremiumPercent",
       "MarketValueInDealCcy",
       "MarketValueInReportCcy",
       "ErrorMessage",
   ],
)
response = definition.get_data()

# Using get_stream

stream = definition.get_stream()

Related types

BuySell

Name Value Description
BuySell.BUY 'Buy' buying the option,
BuySell.SELL 'Sell' selling/writing the option. the output amounts calculated with taking buysell into consideration are returned with a reversed sign when the value 'sell' is used. optional. the default value is 'buy'.

IndexResetType

  • InAdvance (resets the index before the start of the interest period),
  • InArrears (resets the index at the end of the interest period)
Name Value Description
IndexResetType.IN_ADVANCE 'InAdvance'
IndexResetType.IN_ARREARS 'InArrears'

InterestCalculationConvention

Name Value Description
InterestCalculationConvention.BOND_BASIS 'BondBasis'
InterestCalculationConvention.MONEY_MARKET 'MoneyMarket'
InterestCalculationConvention.NONE 'None'
